abstract: A case of breast cancer with choriocarcinomatous features (BCCF) is reported. The patient was a 38-year-old Japanese female with a long history of schizophrenia. Her nursing staff noticed a palpable mass in her right breast, which showed rapid growth. Following cytopathologic confirmation of a malignant breast tumor, she underwent mastectomy with ipsilateral axillary lymph node dissection. Histologic examination revealed BCCF, which was positive for placental alkaline phosphatase and human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) by immunohistochemistry. The serum HCG level was high. She died 7 months postoperatively, with multiple metastases of BCCF to the chest wall, lung and liver.
abstract_ja: 38歳日本人女性の、絨毛癌様の特徴を持つ乳癌（BCCF）の症例を報告する。統合失調症の長い既往がある。看護スタッフが右乳房の触知可能な腫瘤に気づき、急速な増大を示した。細胞診により悪性乳腺腫瘍が確認された後、乳房切除術と同側腋窩リンパ節郭清を受けた。組織学的に、免疫組織化学で胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼおよびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性のBCCFが認められた。血清hCG値は高値であった。術後7か月で死亡し、胸壁、肺、肝への多発転移を伴っていた。
